title: Broken input — trunk plus wrist and ankle dots
question: Exp 13's best control (trunk on every frame, full skeleton on keyframes) lost free-limb actions like kicks. Do wrist and ankle dots on every frame bring them back, and how many keyframes should the limbs get?
source_dir: ../Exp 14 - Brokent input, Photoreal output, Entropy frame pick 3
